import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count'] * 100
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'].plot(kind='bar', color='#e74c3c', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution: Fraud vs Non-Fraud
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'].hist(bins=30, alpha=0.6, label='Non-Fraud', color='#3498db', ax=ax2)
df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'].hist(bins=30, alpha=0.6, label='Fraud', color='#e74c3c', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud by hour of day
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = hourly_fraud['sum'] / hourly_fraud['count'] * 100
ax3.plot(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], marker='o', color='#e74c3c', linewidth=2, markersize=6)
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 4. Box plot: Amount by fraud status
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
df_plot = df.copy()
df_plot['Fraud Status'] = df_plot['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Non-Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df_plot, x='Fraud Status', y='amount', palette={'Non-Fraud': '#3498db', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Status', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Heatmap: Fraud count by transaction type and hour bins
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['hour_bin'] = pd.cut(df['hour_of_day'], bins=[0, 6, 12, 18, 24], labels=['Night (0-6)', 'Morning (6-12)', 'Afternoon (12-18)', 'Evening (18-24)'], include_lowest=True)
heatmap_data = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1].groupby(['transaction_type', 'hour_bin']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Reds', cbar_kws={'label': 'Fraud Count'}, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Fraud Count by Type & Time Period', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Time Period', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)

# 6. Overall fraud statistics
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
fraud_counts = df['is_fraud'].value_counts()
colors = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c']
labels = ['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(fraud_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
                                     colors=colors, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax6.set_title('Overall Fraud Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
